今日證言：

由當時最早識破
🌸☄️假裝不合是整人節目
的🐧出庭作證：

-🌸原本因為背痛不克前往☄️🏠吃起士火鍋

-姊街了解情況後親自邀請🌸

-🌸便改口願意在自己的配信結束後出席

-🌸就這麼簡單的出現在☄️🏠了。這怎麼可能是商業？

Testimony of the Day:

🐧, who was the first to see through the 🌸☄️ “pretending to not get along” prank show,

took the stand.

- 🌸 originally couldn’t go to ☄️’s 🏠 for cheese fondue due to her back pain.

- Anemachi learned about the situation and personally invited 🌸.

- 🌸 then changed her mind and agreed to attend after finishing her own stream.

- 🌸 casually showed up at ☄️’s house. How could this possibly be business-related?
